listingTitle: Implement Rust From instead of Into
title: Implement Rust From instead of Into
why: Implementing From provides the reciprocal Into implementation automatically and keeps conversion ownership on the destination type.
suggestion: Replace the Into implementation with the equivalent From implementation unless coherence rules prevent it.
limitations: The rule recognizes direct Into and std::convert::Into trait paths without performing name or macro resolution.
Lint allowances generated by macros are not visible to source-token analysis.
